key_takeaways: Cost per guest is not one number: food, drinks and per-person transfers rise with each guest, while items such as sound, staging and basic decor stay relatively flat whatever the head count.

Our Italy cost guide puts catering at €150 to €220 per guest for a strong destination-wedding standard, and our Fiji cost breakdown says each guest beyond the package adds about FJD $130 to $180 or more per person.
A minimum spend or guest minimum is charged however few people attend, so a small wedding can cost more per head than the per-person rate suggests.
Guests usually cover their own flights and most accommodation, while couples host the celebration; anything beyond that, from transfers to rooms for parents, is a hosting choice to set out early.
Figures stay in each guide's own currency; convert at the rate on the day you pay and keep a buffer for movement.

faq.q: How much does a destination wedding cost per guest?
faq.a: There is no single figure, because it depends on the destination and on which lines you host. As one starting point, our Italy cost guide puts catering at €150 to €220 per guest for a strong destination-wedding standard, before drinks, transfers and taxes. The table above sets out what our other guides publish, each in its own currency.

faq.q: Do you have to pay for guests at a destination wedding?
faq.a: Not for everything. Guests usually cover their own flights and most accommodation, while couples host the celebration. Anything beyond that, such as group transfers, a welcome event or rooms for close family, is your choice, so tell guests early and in writing what is covered.

faq.q: Is a destination wedding cheaper per guest than a wedding at home?
faq.a: Not reliably. A wedding abroad often adds lines a home wedding may not, such as guest rooms, boat or seaplane transfers and per-person levies. Our side-by-side comparison of overseas and home budgets sets the two out in full.

faq.q: Why is our cost per guest higher with fewer guests?
faq.a: Because fixed lines, minimum spends and guest minimums are shared by fewer people. The section on guest count above shows the effect in our small Italy guide's own per-guest bands.

faq.q: What per-person taxes apply at a destination wedding?
faq.a: It depends on the destination. Our Maldives cost guide and our hidden-costs guide both list a green tax charged per person, and venues may add service charges and local taxes on top of a menu price, as the taxes section above sets out. Confirm the current rate and how each charge applies with your venue or resort before you budget it.
